vanilla_changes.change: Added: SLS/LCL/SLS (S = any sapling, L = any log, C = compass) -> Nature's Compass. Shapeless repair: Nature's Compass + compass -> Nature's Compass.

new_content.name: Nature's Compass
new_content.how_to_obtain: Crafted: shaped recipe with a compass in the center, logs on the edges and saplings on the corners.
new_content.notes: Pattern SLS / LCL / SLS, S = any sapling, L = any log, C = compass.

mechanics.title: Biome search
mechanics.description: Right-click to open the biome selection screen, search for a biome or view its info, and start the search. Information about the found biome is shown on the HUD.

mechanics.title: Reset
mechanics.description: Shift + right-click resets the compass state.

mechanics.title: Config
mechanics.description: Blacklisted biomes and maximum search distance are adjustable in the config file.

getting_started: Craft the compass, right-click it, pick a biome from the list and follow the pointer.
editor_notes: Structure counterpart is Explorer's Compass. Mod ships 2 advancements (not inspected).
name: Nature's Compass
summary: Adds a compass that searches for a chosen biome anywhere in the world and shows information about it. When it is not tracking a biome it points at world spawn.
